PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-001.description: Bounded single writer; read pragmas; WAL, foreign keys and busy timeout; FTS5, sqlite-vec and online backup in the same pinned binary; context cancellation and one workspace lock.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-002.description: Namespace external kinds; distinct collections/records/views/containers; resolve records before relations; distinguish unlink, move and trash.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-003.description: Preserve source actors, timestamps, places, comment anchors and raw unsupported payloads independently from local mutation actors.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-004.description: Use bundled SQLite and FTS5, registered pinned sqlite-vec; immutable assets and versioned migrations; no arbitrary user extension loading or secrets in workspace manifests.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-005.description: Typed DTOs, schema validation and shell-independent services; compound changes use atomic batches; only domain services resolve paths and execute SQL.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-006.description: Inventory safely; parse into canonical intermediate representation; stable mappings; staged commits; link resolution; complete reconciliation and derived indexing.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-007.description: HTML/API adapters use authorized roots, bounded retries, pagination, resumable cursors and explicit attachment/comment/transcript availability.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-008.description: Structural chunking; rebuildable FTS/vector generations; content/model hashes; page/block/meeting source locations in results.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-009.description: Separate local LLM, embedding, retriever and context-builder interfaces; current-source checks; validated citations and reviewed tool proposals.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-010.description: Persist original audio before recognition; separate capture/transcription/summary states and recoverable retries; timestamped transcript segments.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-011.description: Read/create/modify/delete policy enforced by services; local AI creation asks by default; external delete/raw-file access denied unless explicitly permitted.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-012.description: Qualified capabilities; credentials remain native; persisted provenance/session state; bounded processes; one mutating provider run; commit-time scope/revision/idempotency validation.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-013.description: Unmodified official runtime with provider-owned authentication and supported tool restriction; parse terminal result/error; explicit resume and cancellation.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-014.description: Qualified official account/app-server flows; keychain secrets; supported preview limits; reviewed application-owned handoffs without hidden reasoning or inherited wider approvals.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-015.description: Persist transactional claims, attempt/progress/error/timestamps; resumable UI progress; idempotent derived work and bounded concurrency.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-016.description: Eligible origins explicit; atomically deduplicate local effects; occurrence keys, timezones and bounded catch-up; no exactly-once promise for external effects.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-017.description: Approved filesystem roots; OS secrets; ZIP traversal and active HTML defense; untrusted AI context; permissioned tools; validated backup integrity.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-018.description: Online database snapshot with pinned asset lease and hashes; versioned migrations and pre-migration backup; restore to staging and activate only after validation.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-019.description: Restore page checkpoints into a new revision without rewinding shared schemas/unrelated records; validate trash referents and preserve complete backup histories/assets.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-020.description: Redacted local application/job/import/model/search diagnostics; optional user-generated support bundle with explicit content inclusion.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-021.description: Measure cold start near 2 seconds, typical keyword queries under 300 ms, hybrid search under 1 second excluding rerank; editing remains responsive during jobs.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-022.description: Versioned filter AST, stable sorts/groups and view settings; parameterized SQLite queries; P1 relation/rollup/formula behavior remains separately qualified.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-023.description: Published type/function/coercion/error/clock rules; bounded interpreter and regex; cycle detection; stable relation IDs; captured values separate from evaluated results.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-024.description: Offline sanitizing Tiptap/Shiki/Mermaid/KaTeX/PDF rendering; strict Mermaid, untrusted equations and scoped file IDs.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-025.description: Approved external references; honor ignore/security rules; retain file identity/hash/extractor version; tombstone missing files without deleting referring pages.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-026.description: Versioned bounded private-pipe protocol; stdout protocol-only; cancellation/resources/model handles; signed helpers and no workspace.db writes or cloud fallback.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-027.description: Exact compatible format/hash/license/runtime/architecture manifests; distinct chat/embedding/speech packs; explicit resumable download/offline import; no universal fixed model choice.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-028.description: Prioritize recording/editor; bounded workers, idle unloading and memory pressure; durable audio; macOS CPU/Metal qualification and restricted bundled decoder.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-029.description: Approved scoped context/preferences/decisions; current evidence checks; source invalidation; immediate retrieval exclusion on forgetting; no duplicate live-task authority.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-030.description: Fixed memory/no-memory comparison for constraints, conflicts, deletion and unknown answers; track correctness, citations, latency and correction effort.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-031.description: One installed desktop app with signed helpers; offline model packs; platform prerequisites; protected rollback; workspaces preserved on uninstall.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-032.description: Same single-owner kernel behind authenticated encrypted HTTP; verified snapshots for handoff; no live database sharing or implied offline sync.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-033.description: Official MCP SDK bridge to owning kernel; remote transport opt-in/authenticated; explicit destination/context; writes approved; optional to offline operation.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-034.description: Clean install, offline, reconciliation, hostile input, crash, restore and forgetting; hashes/licenses; native packaged app permissions/audio/clipboard/lifecycle checks distinct from browser tests.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-035.description: macOS Apple Silicon first; Windows/Linux shipping requires separate installer/WebView/media/capture/offline qualification.

PRODUCT.CONSTRAINT-036.description: Memory improves task correctness without overriding authoritative newer records; each surfaced decision has evidence or explicit preference label.
